name: Create the Carbon Force Detailing Facebook Page
rules_notes: Free. Category: Car Wash or Automotive Service (pick the closest real one). Set the address to hidden or show only the general area. Do NOT tick any 'service area / we travel to you' option.
next_action: Create the Page, add your existing logo + flyer, fill About with prices and 'drop-off only'.

name: Prepare the Instagram account
rules_notes: Free. See playbooks/instagram-setup.md for the bio, highlights and first 3 posts. Switch to a free Professional (Business) account.
next_action: Pick the handle, create the account, post the first 3 approved posts before telling people about it.

name: Google Business Profile - check eligibility FIRST
rules_notes: Google's guidelines say a profile that SHOWS an address needs permanent signage with the business name at that address. A service-area profile (hidden address) is meant for businesses that travel to customers - you don't, so don't pick that just to hide your address. Options: (1) put up permanent signage (check Village rules first) and show the address, or (2) skip GBP for now and focus on Facebook/Instagram/referrals. Name must be exactly 'Carbon Force Detailing' - no keywords.
next_action: Decide on signage (call Village Hall about home-business rules), then create the profile if eligible.
source_of_info: Google Business Profile guidelines, checked Oct 2026.

name: Village of Melrose Park - home business rules
rules_notes: I couldn't find Melrose Park's home-occupation / business license rules online. Ask whether a home-based drop-off business needs a license and whether a small sign is allowed. Not legal advice - just the right question to ask.
next_action: Call Village Hall and write down what they say.
source_of_info: melrosepark.org Home & Property page lists the phone number.

name: Village of Melrose Park official Facebook group/page
url_or_contact: Find via melrosepark.org (the Village promoted its Facebook group and Instagram page in 2022)
rules_notes: Official village group - expect strict rules. Assume no ads until you read the rules.
next_action: Find it, read the rules, record the rule type. Join as a resident.

name: Search Facebook: Melrose Park community groups
url_or_contact: Facebook search: 'Melrose Park IL', 'Melrose Park neighbors', 'Melrose Park moms', 'Melrose Park buy sell'
rules_notes: Add each real group you find as its OWN opportunity with its name and link, then record its rule type. Public groups only; don't scrape member lists.
next_action: Search, add 2-3 real groups as separate rows.
source_of_info: Search task - no specific groups verified yet.

name: Search Facebook: nearby town groups (short drive to drop off)
url_or_contact: Search: Stone Park, Maywood, Bellwood, Franklin Park, Elmwood Park, River Grove, Northlake, Berkeley, Broadview, Westchester, River Forest
rules_notes: Closest towns first - people won't drive far for a drop-off. Many groups have a weekly business-promo thread; use that instead of a standalone post.
next_action: Find 1 group per town for the closest 4 towns; add each as a row.
source_of_info: Search task - no specific groups verified yet.

name: Nextdoor business page (free)
rules_notes: Free business page. Neighbors can recommend you. Don't post ads in the main neighborhood feed - use the business page. Don't buy Nextdoor ads.
next_action: Create the free page once Facebook Page is live.

name: Bing Places + Apple Business Connect (free)
rules_notes: Free listings. Same eligibility question as Google: they show where customers come to you. Do after the Village/signage question is answered.
next_action: Wait until GBP decision is made, then list consistently (same name, phone, wording everywhere).

name: Yelp business page (free) - careful with reviews
rules_notes: Yelp does not allow asking customers for reviews. Never send the review-request template with a Yelp link. Ignore Yelp's ad sales calls.
next_action: Optional. Claim/create a free page later.

name: Melrose Park Chamber of Commerce & Community Development
rules_notes: Membership has dues (see mpcccd.org/benefits-dues) - that costs money, so decide before joining. Chamber events/newsletters may still be useful to know about.
next_action: Look at dues and upcoming events. Don't join until you decide it's worth the money.

name: Nearby independent auto repair / tire shops (3)
url_or_contact: Find on Google Maps within ~10 min. Use their PUBLIC business phone or walk in.
rules_notes: They don't detail, so it's not competition. Ask to leave flyers or if they ever get asked about cleaning. One personal ask each - no mass messaging.
next_action: Pick 3 real shops, add each as its own row, visit one this week.
source_of_info: Category idea - no specific business contacted.

name: Small used-car lots (sellers want clean cars)
url_or_contact: Google Maps 'used car dealer' near Melrose Park. Public business contact only.
rules_notes: Pitch: you clean cars before they list them, drop-off at your garage. Be clear about your daily max - don't promise volume you can't handle.
next_action: Add 2 real lots as rows; visit one in person.
source_of_info: Category idea - no specific business contacted.

name: Community bulletin boards (library, laundromats, grocery stores)
url_or_contact: Melrose Park Public Library and local businesses with public boards
rules_notes: Ask staff before pinning a flyer. Note which places allow it.
next_action: Bring 10 flyers on your next errand run; ask at 2 places.
source_of_info: Category idea - verify each board's policy in person.

name: Village-wide garage sales (3rd weekend, May-Sept)
rules_notes: Off-season now. Next spring: lots of neighbors out on foot - a flyer stack and your garage looking sharp.

name: Past-customer referrals and repeat bookings
url_or_contact: Your own customer list in this app
rules_notes: Only message people who've done business with you. Use the referral and repeat templates. Don't promise a referral reward unless you've decided on one.
next_action: After every completed job: review request (day after), referral ask (a few days later), repeat reminder (~5 weeks).
